title: 2 big data centers are coming to Utah’s coal country. How they’ll be powered has residents ‘up in arms.’
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
2 big data centers are coming to Utah’s coal country. How they’ll be powered has residents ‘up in arms.’

“It’s all descending, these data centers,” said Cindy O’Neil, who tracks the progress of the projects. “They’re setting these things within a couple of miles of homes.”
